title: Accidental Empty Canonical Support File Incident and Fast-Forward Remediation Record

valid_F_CI47_promotion.message: promote(F-CI47): reconcile moving canonical preservation authority

incident.cause: wrong GitHub connector action was invoked while attempting a canonical ref update after the valid F-CI47 promotion had already occurred in a parallel workstream

remediation.method: ordinary fast-forward commit deleting only the accidental empty root file; no force update and no history rewrite

audit_assertions: the valid F-CI47 promotion predates and is the parent of the accidental commit
the accidental commit adds only the empty root file dummy
the remediation commit removes only that file
the remediation tree is byte-identical to the valid F-CI47 promotion tree
src and reference are unchanged by both incident and remediation
the broad canonical workflow is green after remediation
disposition: Keep this branch as immutable audit evidence. Do not merge F-CI47R into integration/f-ci-canonical merely to record the incident, because that would move an already requalified clean canonical postimage and trigger another unnecessary broad qualification cycle.
